name: Kevin A. Mayer
profileSummary: Kevin A. Mayer is an American business executive. He is the co-founder and co-CEO of Candle Media as well as a Founding Partner of Smash Capital. He was briefly CEO of TikTok, and COO of its parent company ByteDance. Prior to joining TikTok, he was a senior executive at Disney for more than 15 years, including as head of Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International.
